content: nwg-displays (github README, verified): output management GUI for sway/Hyprland/Niri inspired by wdisplays/wlay. GUI to arrange displays, apply resolution/scale/refresh via wlr-output-management, save outputs config to text file included by hyprland.conf (monitors.conf) or sway outputs file; also workspace->output assignments; snap-threshold/view-scale. Key pattern: GUI writes a sourced config file rather than owning hyprland.conf wholesale.
